description: Policy-consistent route labels. Every case uses assigned_owner unless it is listed in overrides. An override is allowed only where a client rule in section 4 of the policy file requires a different route than the one the case was historically assigned, and the reading is a recorded team decision. Team proposed rules (T1, T2) never create an override. See README and QUESTIONS.md Q14.
